card.name: Foodlink F&B Holdings
card.summary: Luxury events caterer, casual dining chain (China Bistro, Art of Dum) and banquet operator with 7 centralized kitchens; fresh issue ₹192 Cr plus OFS of up to 88.35 lakh shares; price band not yet in the RHP.
card.financials: FY26 revenue ₹567.50 Cr (+25.9%), EBITDA ₹78.43 Cr (13.82%), PAT ₹29.11 Cr, borrowings ₹24.29 Cr excl. leases; H1 FY27 PAT loss ₹16.15 Cr
card.quota: QIB not less than 75% · NII not more than 15% · Retail not more than 10% (RHP Offer Structure)
positives: Revenue +19.5% FY25, +25.9% FY26; PAT from ₹15.35 Cr loss (FY24) to ₹29.11 Cr; operating cash flow positive every period
Claimed largest organised luxury caterer in India (FY25); 7 kitchens and exclusive F&B mandates
Borrowings only ₹22.38 Cr at Sep 2026 (excl. ₹97.10 Cr leases)
red_flags: H1 FY27 loss ₹16.15 Cr, EBITDA margin 7.35%; profits seasonal and recent
₹113.71 Cr of fresh issue is capex with no sites, approvals or orders; UAE conflict hurt business
No listed peers, company-commissioned industry report; receivables ₹17.74 Cr → ₹60.05 Cr in two years

card.name: Integris Medtech
card.summary: Everstone-backed medical devices maker (cardiovascular devices, clinical diagnostics, scientific lab solutions) with plants in India, Germany and the Netherlands; fresh issue cut to ₹600 Cr (~₹510 Cr for debt repayment) plus a reduced OFS.
card.financials: Not yet analysed — RHP not read

card.name: Matangi Rubber Limited
card.summary: Contract manufacturer of tyre flaps, tubes and 2/3-wheeler tyres (mainly job work for JK Tyre) with five plants in Uttarakhand, Tamil Nadu and Madhya Pradesh; tyre-flap contract manufacturing is 73.4% of FY26 revenue.
card.financials: FY26 revenue ₹129.76 Cr, EBITDA ₹35.06 Cr (27.0%), PAT ₹22.33 Cr; FY25 PAT ₹20.03 Cr; Q1 FY27 PAT ₹6.42 Cr. D/E 0.85, ROE 20.98%. Trailing P/E ~16.6x at ₹172 (22x on post-issue capital) vs peer composite 23.53.
card.quota: QIB up to 50% · NII at least 35% (sNII 1/3, bNII 2/3) · Retail at least 15% (RHP Offer Structure); fresh ~₹99 Cr + OFS ~₹26 Cr at upper band
positives: Revenue ~+28% in FY26 with EBITDA margin 27.0% and PAT ₹22.33 Cr
About ₹45 Cr of the fresh issue repays bank loans (D/E already down from 1.54 to 0.85)
Plants sit close to the main customer's facilities; new 2/3-wheeler and tube capacity started
red_flags: Top five customers were 91.6% of FY26 revenue and 98.1% of Q1 FY27, JK Tyre the key customer
EBITDA margin fell from 30.5% (FY25) to 22.4% (Q1 FY27); new 2/3-wheeler plant at ~39% utilisation
~21% of issue is OFS; Jan 2026 pre-IPO round at ~₹95 bonus-adjusted vs ₹172 band; ₹4.19 Cr recovery suit pending

card.name: Monomark Engineering (India) Limited
card.summary: Industrial O&M (80% of FY26 revenue), project execution and metal fabrication for metals, cement and ports clients; Hindustan Zinc is 35% of revenue; order book ₹1,762 Cr; 100% fresh issue.
card.financials: FY26 revenue ₹561.89 Cr (+18%), PAT ₹25.90 Cr (4.6%), net worth ₹116.74 Cr, borrowings ₹87.34 Cr, operating cash flow only ₹8.14 Cr; Jun-26 quarter revenue ₹142.32 Cr, PAT ₹3.02 Cr.
card.quota: QIB not more than 50% · NII not less than 15% (sNII one-third, bNII two-thirds) · Retail not less than 35% (RHP Issue Structure); employee reservation not found
positives: Order book ₹1,761.92 Cr against FY26 revenue of ₹561.89 Cr
Revenue +18% and PAT +42% in FY26; HZL relationship since 2010
Fresh issue only, no OFS; promoters keep about 66% after the issue
red_flags: Top 5 customers are 79% of FY26 revenue (HZL 35%); HZL can terminate on one month's notice
Operating cash flow ₹8.14 Cr vs PAT ₹25.90 Cr in FY26; receivables up 63%
Entire ₹120 Cr goes to working capital; contingent liabilities 47% of net worth; Jun-26 quarter margin dropped
card.anchor: Pending — anchor bidding not yet held

card.name: Crystal Crop Protection
card.summary: Delhi-based agrochemicals and hybrid seeds maker (80% crop protection, 19% seeds) with 14,700 distributors, raising ₹455 Cr (₹355 Cr fresh, ~₹101 Cr OFS) mostly to repay debt.
card.financials: FY26 revenue ₹3,152 Cr (+17%), EBITDA 14.5%, PAT ₹145 Cr (+22%), RoNW 7.1%, debt ₹820 Cr; Q1 FY27 operating cash flow only ₹43 Cr
card.quota: QIB up to 50% · NII at least 15% · Retail at least 35%
positives: Revenue +17-21% a year; EBITDA margin up from 9.4% to 14.5%
Diversified brands, 18 granted patents, top-three positions in pearl millet and mustard seed
red_flags: CBI and ED excise-refund case (₹75.5 Cr) against the company and two promoters, still pending
~24.6x P/E vs peer average 20x, with RoNW only 7.1%
Heavy working capital: Q1 FY27 operating cash flow ₹43 Cr, receivables up 34% since March

card.name: Mahanadi Coalfields
card.summary: Coal India subsidiary and India's largest single coal producer (21% of FY26 output, Odisha); 100% OFS by CIL of ~₹8,981 Cr, selling 10% and keeping ~90%.
card.financials: FY26 revenue ₹30,550 Cr, PAT ₹10,698 Cr, RoNW 53.8%, almost no debt, ~₹20,000 Cr cash; FY24-26 PAT CAGR -5%, H1 FY27 PAT +7%
card.quota: QIB up to 50% · NII at least 15% · Retail at least 35% of Net Offer
positives: ~8.4x FY26 P/E, in line with Coal India (8.05x) and below peer average 11.6x
Net-cash balance sheet and heavy dividends (₹7,650 Cr paid in FY26)
Scale leader with ~45 years of reserves and low-cost, rail-led operations
red_flags: Revenue, operating EBITDA and PAT fell FY24-26; FY26 profit leans on other income that doubled to ₹3,350 Cr
~69% of sales to thermal power; coal demand projected to decline after FY36
100% OFS, government-controlled parent; very large ~₹9,000 Cr issue limits listing gains
card.anchor: ₹2,295 Cr from 53 anchors (18 Nov, at ₹136); LIC largest at ~₹568 Cr
